_comment: Canonical POST /sandboxes request body. This is the contract the driver must emit. Field names here are the drift surface: if E2B renames one, change it here and both the fake service and the driver's contract test move together. Bootstrap values are not in this body: E2B resumes sandboxes from a snapshot taken after the template's start command ran, so creation-time envVars never reach it. The driver delivers them afterwards through the envd file API.
